notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
This update focuses on amping up the core gameplay by making everything faster, more fluid, and more intense. 

[h2]Summary[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added [b]Boost[/b]
[*][b]Movement[/b] Overhaul
[*]Added [b]Laser Sight[/b]
[*]Map Generation Tweaks
[*][b]Upgrade[/b] Changes & New [b]Stats[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602485/b26b50a49e399f2b97543834c956d608ab266ab4.gif[/img]

[h2]Boost Action[/h2]
[list]
[*]Tanks can now Boost, adding a third core action alongside Shoot and Block.
[*]Boost increases game pace and opens up new possibilities for upgrade synergies.
[*]More boost-related upgrades coming soon!
[/list]

[h2]Movement Overhaul[/h2]
Movement has been reworked for a smoother, faster, and more dynamic experience:
[list]
[*][b]Wall Bounce:[/b] Tanks at high speed will now bounce off walls, adding to the chaos.
[*][b]Wall Avoidance:[/b] Your tank will auto-adjust to avoid walls, letting you focus on combat.
[*][b]Drifting:[/b] Tanks can now drift at high speeds. Drift-related upgrades are coming!
[/list]

[h2]Laser Sight[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added a laser sight that shows the projected path of your shots, including bounces.
[*]Range is now a stat, and the laser sight reflects your current range.
[*]You can also see where enemies are aiming, adding new layers of tactical gameplay.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602485/043bc911fb40024673c6e6aab038cf5c37cc57f6.gif[/img]

[h2]Map Generation Tweaks[/h2]
[list]
[*]Maps now tend to be smaller and more open, encouraging fast-paced combat.
[*]More map changes are planned in future updates!
[/list]

[h2]Upgrade Changes & New Stats[/h2]

Several new upgrades added. Existing upgrades have been tweaked for better balance and synergy.

New stats provide more ways to customize your tank:
[list]
[*][b]Boost Bombs[/b] – Spawn bombs when boosting.
[*][b]Shield Bombs[/b] – Spawn bombs when blocking.
[*][b]Range[/b] – Max distance your projectiles can travel.
[*][b]Boost Cooldown[/b] – Time before boost can be reused.
[*][b]Boost Windup[/b] – Delay before boost activates.
[*][b]Boost Strength[/b] – Speed and distance of boost.
[*][b]Max Speed[/b] – Top speed your tank can reach.
[/list]

[h2]Beta Keys Available[/h2]

Want to try out this version and help shape the future of the game?

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/TJpc8TAEPC]Discord[/url] and ask for a playtest key!

Keys are limited—grab yours before they’re gone.
